entries.name: Liter8 device scope
entries.detail: Project README says iPhone 11 only (n104ap); iPhone 11 Pro/Pro Max profiles are experimental and unverified. It does not claim iPhone 12/A14 support.

entries.name: Liter8 iOS 27.0 build row
entries.detail: Build 24A437 is listed as run for iPhone 11 and experimental for iPhone 11 Pro/Pro Max; this is not evidence for iPhone13,2.

entries.name: iPhone 12 support discussion
entries.detail: A recent GitHub issue asks about A14/iPhone 12 support; a request or discussion is not a maintainer-confirmed successful port or reproducible test.

entries.name: usbliter8 hardware scope
entries.detail: The current Liter8 project credits usbliter8 and explicitly limits its own tested target to A13 iPhone 11; no A14 iPhone 12 validation is provided there.

entries.name: iOS 27.0 signing status
entries.detail: A third-party firmware catalog reports iOS 27.0 build 24A437 for iPhone13,2 as no longer signed. Check Apple's current signing state before any restore; this app does not recommend restoring.

entries.name: Current iOS firmware context
entries.detail: The Apple Wiki firmware index lists iOS 27.2 build 24B119 for iPhone13,2 dated 2026-10-26. This is firmware catalog information, not jailbreak support evidence.

caution: Evidence records are dated snapshots, not exploit instructions. A result for another ProductType, chip, board, or build must not be treated as proof for iPhone13,2 / A14 / 24A437.
